title: Information gathering
detail: Who will use the design? What do they need? The first portfolio entry opens with the research that shapes a brief.

title: The first portfolio
detail: The first site brought the profile and creative work together in one place. The introduction remains the starting point for getting to know the designer.

title: A home for selected work
detail: The project gallery gave each design a place of its own. Browse the collection by discipline to see how the layouts change between websites and interfaces.

title: Client perspectives
detail: A dedicated feedback section joined the portfolio, giving client perspectives a place alongside the finished work.

title: The journey takes shape
detail: Dated milestones joined the project gallery. The alternating layout lets the reader follow the portfolio from its first brief through its later editions.

title: Inside the design
detail: Project pages now take a closer look at composition, type and interaction. The journal follows those decisions from the initial sketch to handoff.
